meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Turn your project timeline into a week-by-week narrative.

howto.what: 把项目的完整历史按 ISO 周拆成多个文件，每周安排一个子代理写一章连续叙述；每章会参考上一周留下的进度块，最终产出一份多章的周报叙事。
howto.when: 当用户提到“weekly digests”、“week-by-week story”、“serial timeline”等，或要求把项目历史写成逐周叙事章节时触发。

howto.what_en: Splits the project's full timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one subagent per week in sequence to write a narrative chapter. Each chapter carries forward the prior week's handoff, producing a multi-chapter weekly digest.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for 'weekly digests', 'week-by-week story', 'serial timeline', or similar weekly narrative summaries of a project's history.
